claim: Blood's open-air maps vary their wall heights: of the 38 campaign maps with open sky none draws its one-sided walls under the sky to one height and 32 draw three or more, but only 17 step the sky between open sectors (141 steps of a body or more; E1M3 29, E3M1 13, E1M1 12; E3M1's largest 15.5 bodies). Variety without a sky step exists: E1M5 has seven wall heights and no sky step. Sloped skies are rare: 23 sectors in 10 maps.
evidence: tools/mine_skylines.py --population blood-campaign: 38 maps with open sky, 0 single-height, 32 with three or more wall heights, 17 with a stepped sky, 141 sky-step portals of a body or more; 10 maps with a sloped sky, 23 sectors
use: Vary a street's skyline by raising roof floors under one sky (skyline.roof); step the sky up only for a thing taller than the rest (skyline.apron).

checked.how: Ran python -m tools.mine_skylines (work copy): 43 maps, 38 open sky, maps_with_one_wall_height 0, three or more 32, stepped sky 17, sky_steps 141, sloped sky 10 maps 23 sectors - all as claimed. per_map: E1M3 29, E3M1 13 (max 15.5 bodies, not 15.4), E1M1 12, E6M1 and E6M6 also 13; E1M5 7 wall heights, 0 steps. The tool counts no raised floors in its summary, so 'most of the variety comes from raised roof floors' had no count: taken out.
